=== PAGE: mark hurst | https://creativegood.com/mark-hurst/
Creative Good: About Mark Hurst
Retrieved via http: https://creativegood.com/mark-hurst/
About Mark Hurst
Mark Hurst is the founder of Creative Good, the New York-based consultancy and creative platform that he founded in 1997. He has spent his career writing, speaking, and advising teams about how to create better products and services. He has created a number of his own projects, too. • Email newsletter: Sign up here • Services: Consulting, workshops, and talks , Good Todo , Media Diet , and Good Reports • Radio show: Techtonic on WFMU , also a podcast . • Books: Customers Included (2015), Bit Literacy (2007) • Apps: Good Todo (Web + iOS), Brooklyn 1776 (iOS, no longer available). • Conferences: Gel and Skeptech (17 events, 2003-2020) For over two decades, Mark Hurst and his team at Creative Good have advised a wide range of clients - in media, healthcare, technology, financial services, ecommerce, and more - about how to build better businesses by treating customers well. Hurst is also the creator of the Good Todo mobile productivity platform, the world's first cross-platform todo list, which he described in his first book, Bit Literacy , which introduced the "empty inbox" method of managing email (now better known as Inbox Zero). Since fall 2017 Hurst has hosted Techtonic - see techtonic.fm - a weekly FM radio show on WFMU . Here's the Techtonic podcast . Also in 2017 Hurst ran two Skeptech events questioning today's digital technology, held at WFMU. Hurst is also the founder and host of the Gel conference , which featured the first stage presentations of Khan Academy, Wikipedia, and other world-changing projects. In 2015 Hurst released the 2nd edition of his book Customers Included , which describes how teams and organizations can create successful products and strategies by including customers. In 2013 Hurst's column The Google Glass feature no one is talking about went viral, gaining worldwide media attention (and translations into six languages ) and starting a conversation about the privacy implications of Google Glass and wearable tech. Brooklyn 1776, the educational mobile videogame by Hurst and the Creative Good team, won the 2016 Brooklyn Innovation Award for best indie video game. Mark Hurst holds bachelor's and master's degrees in computer science from MIT. He's also an Eagle Scout, a patented game designer (U.S. Patent #5048839 ), and studies Mandarin Chinese in his spare time. He lives in New York City with his wife and son. On Mastodon: @markhurst@mastodon.social On Bluesky: @markhurst.bsky.social Email: mark@creativegood.com

Galerie Atrium ed Arte
Retrieved via http: https://atrium-ed-arte.at
aktuelle Informationen der Galerie Atrium ed Arte, Wien
Galerie Atrium ed Arte, Wien
Die Galerie als Fortsetzung der Kunst mit anderen Mitteln
Seit Ende des Jahres 2011 ist der Ausstellungsraum an der Lerchenfelderstrasse 31 in 1070 Wien geschlossen. Nach 15 Jahren Tätigkeit als Galeristin wollte Silvia Grossmann diese Rolle aufgeben, da sie ihre eigene künstlerische Tätigkeit verstärkt verfolgen möchte.
Die Galerie Atrium ed Arte wurde 1996 als Verein gegründet. Es wurden pro Jahr 4-6 Ausstellungen zeitgenössischer Kunst veranstaltet, in deren Rahmen jeweils Lesungen, Konzerte oder Events stattfanden. Arbeiten internationaler zeitgenössischer KünstlerInnen wurden zu Literatur und musikalischen Beiträgen in Beziehung gesetzt und durch Performances und Kunstgespräche die bildende Kunst dem Besucher nähergebracht. Silvia Maria Grossmann leitete die Galerie und war verantwortlich für das Galerieprogramm.
2001, 2003 und 2006 wurde die Galerie mit einem Preis des «Engagierten Auges» der Stadt Wien ausgezeichnet.
Atrium ed Arte wird als Verein bestehen bleiben. Die Website soll weiterhin als Link zwischen Kunstinteressierten und Kunstkäufern und den Künstlerinnen und Künstlern fungieren. Geplant ist auch, dass der Verein weitere Kunstprojekte verwirklicht, dies ohne festen Ausstellungsraum.
Silvia Grossmann möchte sich an dieser Stelle sehr herzlich für die 15 Jahre der ausserordentlich guten Zusammenarbeit mit den Künstlerinnen und Künstlern bedanken, für die Freundschaft, die ihr entgegengebracht wurde und die Bereicherung durch die Galeriearbeit und die Mitwirkenden. Sie hört mit einem «lachenden und einem weinenden Auge» auf und freut sich auf neue Projekte.
Die neue Mieterin in der Lerchenfelderstrasse 31 ist Tina Polisoidis. Aus dem Raum ist ein Schmuckatelier geworden: www.tina-polisoidis.at Bitte nachschauen!
Sollten Sie Interesse an Arbeiten der KünstlerInnen der Galerie haben, bitte klicken Sie auf « Kontakt »!. Ein Email genügt!
Silvia Maria Grossmann

Welkom op de website van Stadscamping Rotterdam !
Stadscamping Rotterdam is de ideale plek voor de toerist die op eenvoudige wijze wil overnachten in Rotterdam. De camping ligt tegenover Diergaarde Blijdorp aan de rand van het centrum nabij de uitvalswegen A20 en A13. Let op ! Per 1 januari 2025 gelden er nieuwe regels voor de milieuzone in Rotterdam, lees verder bij : Route & Contact
Er is een uitstekende busverbinding naar het centrum, in 10 minuten bent u in hartje Rotterdam. Met de fiets bent u net zo snel , te voet een half uurtje.
U kunt bij ons terecht met uw tent, camper of tourcaravan. Heeft u die niet ? Geen probleem ! Neem een slaapzak mee en verblijf in één van onze blokhutten.

Our History
Joseph Debrie founded DEBRIE, a French based manufacturing company specialized in film laboratory equipment.
Together with his son André Debrie, they designed a precision-tooled, very steady and unusually compact camera PARVO. It was a breakthrough technology that quickly became the world's most widely used camera.
DEBRIE invented a new range of MATIPO contact printers tens of thousands of units of which were sold around the world.
DEBRIE introduced a new line of modern laboratory processing machines DNN.
DEBRIE designed the first continuous contact printer TCI that rapidly became a worldwide reference.
DEBRIE was acquired by CTM, a French-based film equipment manufacturer owned by Pierre Frilley.

Conserving 30% of California by 2030
GreenInfo Network is the data partner for California's efforts to conserve 30% of its lands by 2030. We work closely with the state Natural Resources Agency to gather, process, and publish the data California uses to track progress toward this major milestone.
Read more about Conserving 30% of California by 2030
Conservation Lands Network 2.0
Conservation Lands Network 2.0 is a long-term regional strategy and framework to set goals, provide tools, and catalyzes on-the-ground land conservation in the Bay Area. Working closely with TOGETHER Bay Area (formerly the Bay Area Open Space Council), Greeninfo Network worked to completely update and relaunch the Conservation Lands Network and associated web tools. This foundational dataset has been a key guide for regional conservation funding and habitat protection for more than a decade. The update included a complete rerunning of the underlying analysis from 1.0, alongside an extensive reimagining of the online Explorer tool and the Conservation Portfolio report.

Guiding $1.5 billion for equitable park access
California voters have often supported bond measures to help build local parks. The Department of Parks and Recreation is charged with distributing those funds. We created parksforcalifornia.org to showcase that work. It also hosts tools that make it easier for local park advocates to apply for funding, and for the state to ensure those funds are equitably distributed.
Read more about Guiding $1.5 billion for equitable park access
Mapping California’s public lands
Before GreenInfo created the California Protected Areas Database, there was no single source of data about protected lands in California. Now, the database has become a national model and a foundation for a huge range of conservation and park equity work.
Read more about Mapping California’s public lands
PerSquareMile data supports first park needs assessment in Los Angeles since 2009
In early 2025, the City of Los Angeles undertook its first Park Needs Assessment since 2009. GreenInfo joined the team to help determine where new parks would have the most impact. We developed the PerSquareMile tool with UCLA to select 36 locations where new parks would most benefit people who lack park access.
Read more about PerSquareMile data supports first park needs assessment in Los Angeles since 2009

Use industry standards to measure our work.

Build on decades of experience working with a wide range of data.
Give our clients the best mix of speed, accuracy, and repeatability.

Evaluate how we support and lift up institutions that represent marginalized communities.
Produce work that helps our clients center equity and justice.

GreenInfo Network works with clients whose missions focus on environment, public health, education, and social justice. We create maps, data, and web applications that empower our clients and their communities.
About
Mission & overview
Since 1996, GreenInfo has collaborated with more than 1,000 organizations and agencies across the country and even internationally. We deliver user research, data analysis, and thoughtful design.
Our story
GreenInfo Network emerged in the mid 1990s to map regional open space. We combined information from many organizations to create shared data everyone could use. From the beginning, our purpose was not just to help nonprofits and agencies use maps, but also to connect people and groups together. That ensures our work has collective value.
Some of what we do:
Work with local, regional and state agencies to collect data about public lands.
Map school campuses for public health researchers studying tobacco marketing.
Collaborate with tribes and other partners to make maps of proposed national monuments.
Design web applications to help transportation agencies plan for sea level rise.
Assist state officials in equitably distributing millions of dollars in park funds.
Our team
We are data analysts, cartographers, designers, developers, and project managers. We develop data-driven maps, analyses, and reporting tools for a wide range of clients.
Team members collaborate across disciplines to help clients understand what they need to achieve their goals. Then we use the best available technologies to deliver beautiful, reliable, and easy-to-use data, analyses, maps, and tools.
GreenInfo is based in Oakland, California, with remote team members spread across the United States.

Le Manoir aux Quat’Saisons has been a gathering place for the culinary curious for decades, but our history stretches back centuries. Hidden among Oxfordshire hills overlooking the water meadows of the Thames Valley, the estate can be traced back to 1225.
After expansion in the 17th century to add orchards, fishponds and a dovecote, the property passed between Lords and ministers for 300 years before being taken under the custodianship of Raymond Blanc OBE in 1984.
After 41 years of pioneering leadership, Raymond Blanc OBE transitioned to the role of Founder and Lifetime Ambassador as the hotel closed for an exciting redevelopment.

The Belmond Story | Luxury Hotels, Trains, Boats, Safaris
Retrieved via http: https://www.belmond.com/en/about
From our vintage art deco trains to hotels housed in ancient palaces and monasteries, every Belmond property is rich with history. Here’s our story.
About
We were born from a passion for connecting discerning travellers with the world’s most remarkable properties, locations and journeys.
Across hotels, trains, river cruises and safari lodges, Belmond encourages a slower pace of travel that celebrates time, local culture, nature and human connection through memorable experiences and unforgettable stories.
With a 50-year legacy beginning in 1976 with Hotel Cipriani in Venice, Belmond has grown into a global collection of 43 properties across 24 countries. A pioneer of slow travel, we have operated the Venice Simplon-Orient-Express since 1982 and expanded to include beach resorts, historic retreats, iconic city landmarks and gateways to UNESCO World Heritage sites.
As custodians of storied places, Belmond works with local communities and leading creatives to shape the future of travel, and has been part of the world’s leading luxury group, LVMH (Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton), since 2019.

WHO WE ARE
CORE VALUES
HONORS & AWARDS
Lowenstein Sandler LLP is a national law firm with over 400 lawyers based in New York, Palo Alto, Roseland, Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., and Wilmington. We represent clients in virtually every sector of the global economy, with particular strength in the areas of technology, life sciences, and investment funds.
We have built a reputation for pursuing every matter with creativity and passion. Our industry knowledge, entrepreneurial drive, and proven commitment to our communities deliver a different and better law firm experience to our clients. We focus on building long-standing relationships and anticipating our clients’ needs, rather than responding to them. Working side-by-side with our clients, we serve not only as lawyers, but as trusted advisors.
We approach each case, each client, and each other with integrity and respect, and our award winning pro-bono work enables us to connect individuals and communities with unimaginable success.
We see our colleagues as family and commit to the personal development, support, and mentorship of all those under our roof. We work tirelessly to create a fully inclusive environment in which differing views and perspectives are welcomed and honored.
Content Values
CLIENT-FIRST ALWAYS We are fiercely committed to exceptional client service. We listen , anticipate needs, and deliver with clarity and care. BOLDLY INNOVATIVE We don’t just respond, we value forward thinking , fresh ideas , and the courage to question the status quo. ENTREPRENEURIAL AT HEART We build smart solutions for our clients and our firm with an emphasis on ownership and results . PURPOSEFULLY CONNECTED We build strong relationships—with clients , colleagues , and communities . We create impact by connecting people and opportunities. GENEROUS BY NATURE We give generously of our time , talent , and insight . Whether supporting a colleague, advising on the business of law, or advancing a cause, we show up with purpose.

About the Firm
History
Executive Leadership
Our Values
Dechert helps business leaders lead
For more than 150 years, we’ve advised the innovators who move industries forward. From the railroad pioneers of the 19 th century to the world’s top asset managers today, we help leaders uncover opportunity and unlock advantage.
Boldly commercial
Beyond protecting your business, we work to advance it. We find the upside others miss so you can seize opportunities and move with speed to market. We anticipate challenges around the corner to help you avoid litigation or defend your business — because all litigation is high stakes.
Intrepid teamwork, global reach
Our lawyers across the U.S., Europe, Asia, and the Middle East are immersed in the sectors we serve, including financial services, private capital, real estate, life sciences, and technology. We work shoulder to shoulder with you, and with each other, bringing together global insights, commercial judgment and the full depth of our collective thinking. So, you have access to top legal resources wherever you operate and can move decisively when opportunity demands it.
Innovation is in our DNA
No precedent? No problem. Whether in emerging areas of law like AI or writing novel deal structures in real estate and private equity, we stay ahead so you can, too. Dechert has had more lawyers recognized by the Financial Times Innovative Lawyers Awards in North America than any other firm.
Excellence is standard
You expect steady hands, sharp judgment and a battle-tested command of the law. That’s what our lawyers bring to every negotiation, courtroom and conversation. And we bring the same commitment to our pro bono work and advocacy. Wherever business moves next, we’ll be there. Ahead of market shifts and regulatory tides, investing and unwavering. Helping leaders achieve the uncommon.

Culture
We believe building community within the workplace and with our clients is the key to success. It's about building a firm where people are trusted and empowered to do their best.
Dechert’s five key values – excellence, stewardship, diversity and inclusion, collaboration, and innovation – underscore our inclusive approach and embody our commitment to our work, clients, and talent.

With a long-standing tradition of providing legal services to those who cannot otherwise afford counsel, we approach pro bono engagements with the same energy, enthusiasm and resources as we do for commercial clients.

Culture
Retrieved via http: https://www.dechert.com//about/our-culture.html
We are proud to be a firm of talented lawyers and extraordinary people who respect each other and work well together. Learn more about our culture.
It takes a committed, global team to deliver the excellence in service and innovative thinking our clients expect. Cultivating creativity to harness the very best ideas comes from respecting and valuing everyone’s voice , and creating a shared enjoyment in all that we do. At Dechert, we believe that building community within the workplace and with our clients – whether multinational companies or pro bono causes – is the key to success. It’s about building a firm where people are trusted and empowered to do their very best.
We're proud that Dechert has been certified for a eighth year in a row in the U.S. as a great workplace by the independent analysts at Great Place to Work®. Some of the positive acknowledgements we received included:
— 88% of respondents say Dechert is a great place to work — 97% say people are treated fairly here regardless of their sexual orientation — 91% say they are proud to tell people that they work here — 93% say when you join the company, you are made to feel welcome
To see more survey results, visit Dechert’s Great Place to Work page .
360 degrees of well-being
True well-being is more than physical health. It is a full-circle outlook on the whole self. Find out how THRIVE@Dechert can help you achieve all-around well-being.
Firm Culture Initiatives
Gratitude
"Gratitude is a powerful thing,” said Dechert's former-Chair Andy Levander. “A meaningful ‘thank you’ makes people on both sides of that conversation feel good, so we wanted to help people make a regular habit of gratitude.”
Specially designed postcards are distributed to employees, on which they can write brief notes of appreciation to be sent to fellow colleagues.
As COVID-19 led to remote working, it was more important than ever to ensure our community maintained the bonds of connection and gratitude — accordingly, we adapted our postcards to become e-gratitude cards and over 1,000 cards were sent in the first week.
Well-being Week
Our people cannot achieve their fullest potential – and deliver exceptional client service – without taking the time to invest in and rejuvenate themselves. Dechert is dedicated to promoting a healthy integration of work and personal life through our THRIVE@Dechert Framework. This framework focuses on the physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being of our people. We provide access to resources such as: online fitness programs, tele-medicine assistance for both physical and mental health, as well as webinars and virtual support groups on a variety of topics. Every year, Dechert's global community participates in Well-being Week . It's a great time to support each other and embrace healthier living habits. Some of our activities have included a "what brings you joy" photo contest, a global steps challenge and a financial well-being seminar.
Innovation@Dechert
We Celebrate and Receive Recognition for Innovative Ideas
We take great pride in the innovative ideas and approaches that our people take, whether in relation to client work, the client experience, or internally supporting our business operations. It is important that we acknowledge and recognize everyone for their contributions, and we do this in a variety of ways.
Annually, we recognize the efforts and accomplishments of our people who are making a difference on the innovation front through our Innovator Award but the recognition doesn’t stop there. Members of the Innovation Certificate Program are all recognized for their commitment to innovation when they pitch their ideas to the chief executives across the firm. The firm has a network of Innovation Ambassadors who are featured in articles, interviews and the like for their contributions to the firm and our clients on this front.
Externally, the firm has received recognition for our unique Innovation Certificate Program and our Summer Associate Innovation Bootcamp. To learn more, click here .
Diversity and Inclusion Week
All of us at Dechert earnestly strive to be more inclusive leaders within the firm and across the legal industry. During our annual Diversity and Inclusion Week , all members of our community are invited to participate in a variety of engaging and enlightening events to celebrate Dechert’s culture of inclusion.
Dechert’s Birthday Week
Each year we come together to celebrate the anniversary of Dechert's founding in 1875. It offers us an opportunity to learn about our firm’s history, celebrate where we are today and look ahead to where we’re going.
Dechert hosts a number of fun activities with colleagues as part of Birthday Week – previous events have included a special birthday cake class with a renowned chef, volunteer sessions for writing letters to first responders, deployed troops, isolated elders and sick children and a Dechert history quiz to name a few.
We’re grateful to all the members of our Dechert community who continue to honor and fulfill the firm’s most important traditions: our commitment to quality, exceptional service for our clients and a culture that values people.
Dechert Stars
We celebrate colleagues who make significant contributions to our Dechert community. “Dechert Stars” recognizes those for their willingness to share their innovative ideas, teach others what they know, promote inclusion, or be a positive force for change.
Watch this video to learn more about Dechert Stars .
Day of Service
One of our proudest annual traditions is the Dechert Day of Service. As part of our shared commitment to the communities in which we live and work, each Dechert office takes its own unique action to help our neighbors and make our cities better places for all.

Dechert core values are excellence, innovation, collaboration, diversity and stewardship.
Five key values – excellence, stewardship, diversity and inclusion, collaboration, and innovation – form the foundation of the Dechert culture. These values guide our decision-making and behavior and embody our commitment to our work, our clients and our community.
Excellence
We practice at the forefront of the legal profession to serve our clients’ needs. We work with our clients to confront complex challenges, solve the most intractable problems, and drive positive business results. We think strategically and commercially, pay meticulous attention to detail, and we invest in technology and training to consistently improve our service.
Stewardship
Our lawyers and business professionals are stewards of something much bigger than our individual practices or jobs. We are accountable not only to ourselves, but to each other, the Firm, our clients, and the communities where we live and work. Whatever our role, we care about how well we do it, and we feel empowered and equipped to make a positive difference.
Diversity and Inclusion
We value and respect the unique experiences and talents of our individual team members, and those differences enrich our client relationships. Our inclusive workplace fosters innovative thinking and creative problem-solving, where teams can draw from varied backgrounds and viewpoints to develop effective legal strategies. Read more.
Collaboration
We bring together diverse perspectives and experience across practices and geographies to address challenges with precision and ingenuity. We advise clients across their priority markets globally, offering insights on local nuance, laws, and regulations – and we work together to help our clients understand how those dynamics affect our clients’ business from all angles.
Innovation
Building on a long history of innovation, we continue to invest in technology and nurture an innovative mindset to provide excellent client service. In 2024, we were recognized among the most innovative law firms in the world by the Financial Times. We also had more lawyers ranked as “Innovative Legal Practitioners” in North America than any other firm and we were the only firm with lawyers ranked in the Top 10 across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. How the buying process works
Selecting the right domain for your business or blog is a big commitment. If you're not familiar with HugeDomains, this page provides basic information for first-time customers regarding the buying process.
What happens when you purchase a domain name from HugeDomains.com?
HugeDomains is the registered owner of every domain listed for sale on our site. When you purchase a domain from us, you are purchasing exclusive registration rights to that domain.
Once payment has been received, 3 things happen:
We have the current registrar (NameBright.com) create a new account for the buyer.
Next, we request that the domain be transferred to the buyer's account.
Finally, we'll relinquish control of the domain. The buyer will in turn become the new registrant of the domain, and will assume full control of the domain. *
* When a domain is purchased on a payment plan, a registrar lock is placed on the domain until all payments have been made. This registrar lock prevents transfers.
How does domain ownership work?

PixelBull Case Study | HugeDomains
Retrieved via http: https://www.hugedomains.com/case-study-pixelbull.cfm
PixelBull creates stunning designs and videos for you to stand out in your industry.
A design and video production company born out of the pandemic
PixelBull creates stunning designs and videos for it's clients — specializing in award winning graphic design, web design, video editing, and motion graphics.
How did you first start your business?
When COVID-19 first hit, a lot of in-house designers were laid off as company's scrambled to cut costs. But those companies still needed design work done, then and now. That's why we decided to seize the opportunity to innovate a whole new way of providing top-quality designers to companies with a variety of design needs. Today, we offer all the benefits of a full-time, remote design team at a competitively low cost.
What services do you provide?
We provide unlimited design work, including video editing and motion graphics, for a flat monthly price. Revolutionizing the design and video-editing industry, we provide USA-based designers at a fraction of the cost. Instead of charging by the hour or the project, we work on a subscription basis so that our clients never have to worry about budgeting for individual design needs throughout the month.
How did you hone in on your name?
PixelBull means a few different things. I always knew I wanted to use the word “pixel” in our company name, since pixels are such a core element of what we do—web design, graphic design, video editing, and motion graphics. The word “bull” references our desire to push through the aggressive pricing of design agencies that charge high hourly rates, and we also feel strongly about providing a “no bull” guarantee for our work.
How do you make a small business bigger?
It's important to remember to take small steps before big steps. I've always loved the saying “think globally, work locally,” and I think this is one of the keys to growing a business. Having functional systems set up for each aspect of your business is crucial. Whether its hiring, advertising, content creation, or sales, everything needs a system. When small businesses start out, they typically don't have these kinds of systems in place, but if you take the right incremental steps toward growth, everything starts to fit together like a puzzle.
What major challenges have you had to overcome?
Hiring has been one of our biggest issues. The work we do requires extreme skill, talent, and most importantly, creativity, and it can be hard to find designers who meet these standards. We've made the mistake of hiring based on outstanding portfolio examples, only to discover that the work doesn't always measure up. As we've grown, we've begun systemizing our hiring process. We now ask candidates to demonstrate a few role-related tasks before deciding whether to interview. This functions as a filter and allows us to streamline and optimize our hiring process.
How do people build a brand online?
The most important thing to remember when building a brand — whether its online or offline — is to focus on the brand itself rather than on product promotion. A brand encompasses everything, from your domain to your logo, your color scheme, slogan, and social media. All these elements should align with your brand's style, message, and aesthetic. Consumers are constantly inundated with branding, but the ones that truly stand out have the edge of consistency and creativity. Put simply, be memorable and be consistent.

=== PAGE: chairman message | https://www.millat.com.pk/about/chairman-message/
Chairman Message - Millat Tractors Limited
Retrieved via http: https://www.millat.com.pk/about/chairman-message/
I feel pleasure in welcoming you to the website of Millat Tractors Limited, an ISO 9002 Certified Company for its Assembly Plants and Material Testing & Gauge Control Laboratories. Today this Company has become Pakistan’s leading engineering concern in the automobile sector.
It is manufacturing internationally acclaimed tractors, Diesel Engines, Diesel Generating Sets & Prime Movers, Forklift Trucks under License with Anhui Heli Company Limited China and a range of Agricultural Implements.
The Company’s product-spread encompasses the length and breadth of the country with Millat tractors population around 259,000 units giving it a market share of more than 50%. The company was established in 1964 and the Assembly Plant was set-up in 1967 on Sheikhupura Road, Lahore, initially to assemble MF Tractors imported in Semi Knocked down Condition.
In the early 80’s, the Government of Pakistan decided on indigenization of tractors, which was a turning point for the Company and it went about the task methodically and rapidly, in close collaboration with Massey Ferguson. Side by side Millat Tractors established sophisticated manufacturing facilities for machining of intricate and critical components like engine block, sump, cylinder head, transmission case, axle housing, hydraulic cover, front axle support and center housing. In 1992, the new Tractor Assembly Plant, with a capacity of 16,000 tractors, on a single shift basis, started production. This was a quantum jump to the quality of assembled tractors and pushed Millat Tractors into the rank of major tractor manufacturing companies of the world.
MTL believes in providing best value for money to its customers. Complete customers’ satisfaction is our cherished goal. There is a constant endeavor at all levels of the organization to better the company’s performance by offering upgraded range of its products and services. MTL’s cardinal principle has been to keep abreast with the latest technology. Our technological collaboration with AGCO Limited UK and M/s Anhui Heli Forklift Trucks China has been of great help in upgrading technology levels and introducing new models. Whereas one of its sister concern Bolan Casting Limited, the biggest automotive casting company of the Country, is providing castings of international standards for local as well as Customers from abroad.
The Company looks to the future with optimism and plans to broaden its customer base. The challenges like WTO and globalization have been taken with success in mind. Ambitious goals with calculated targets have been set and to achieve these goals and objectives, well defined strategies in Production, Procurement, Administration Finance and Marketing have been framed out. A strict monitoring system has also been set in place to ensure proper follow up.
Consequently the opportunities are being explored in multi-application of engines and tractors in areas other then the farming sector. Mass production of Generating Sets was started in 1994, while a 3 ton Forklift Truck branded as “Millat” was launched in the year 2002.
The Company is proud of providing a strong “vendor base” to the country’s Engineering Industry and also being a pioneer in bringing in the new technologies and equipment. Another company named Millat Equipment Limited has been established that would cater for the upcoming demand of “Gears” for automotive industry of the Country as well as export market.
I attribute our success to the support provided by our Customers, Principals, Dealers, Vendors, and of course the dedicated Employees for which I am deeply grateful.
Your Comments and suggestions are always welcome which indeed help us in making further improvements. Thank you for visiting us.
Sikandar M. Khan
Chairman Millat Group of Companies

Como empresa responsable y comprometida con la sociedad, Petroperú abre sus puertas a instituciones educativas, institutos de educación superior, universidades, entidades públicas y privadas, así como a la ciudadanía en general, para que conozcan los procesos de la industria de hidrocarburos a través de visitas guiadas en sus operaciones a nivel nacional.
Las visitas dirigidas a estudiantes universitarios y de educación técnica se desarrollan en el marco de los programas de responsabilidad social de la empresa, con el objetivo de complementar la formación académica mediante experiencias prácticas en entornos reales de operación. Estas se realizan exclusivamente en grupos organizados y no de manera individual.
Para solicitar una visita, la institución interesada debe remitir una carta dirigida a Petroperú, debidamente firmada y sellada por el representante de la entidad. La solicitud deberá presentarse a través de la mesa de partes virtual de la empresa.
El día de la visita, los participantes deberán cumplir con los requisitos y procedimientos de seguridad establecidos por la empresa, que incluyen la presentación de documento de identidad (DNI), Seguro Complementario de Trabajo de Riesgo (SCTR), así como el uso de vestimenta y calzado adecuados. Durante el recorrido, personal especializado brindará explicaciones claras sobre los procesos de refinación y los estándares internacionales aplicados en la operación.

Tips & råd
Vi ger dig tipsen du behöver för att lyckas. Läs våra guider och få hjälp av våra trädgårdsmästare och växtkunniga.
Trädgårdskalender för hösten – det här kan du göra i trädgården nu
På hösten sänker sig lugnet över trädgården, och du kan förbereda dig för vintern och den kommande våren, samtidigt som du gläds åt höstblommande växter.
Hebe – fakta och skötselråd
Hebe fyller utekrukorna med sitt täta bladverk och sina färgstarka blommor långt in på hösten. De finns i många varianter – från små, kompakta sorter till blommande sorter i vitt, rosa, lila eller blått. Upptäck olika hebe här och få tips på hur du sköter om dem.
Välj rätt jord och gödsel till uteväxter
Bra jord och gödsel är a och o för att få sunda, friska och fina växter över hela säsongen – oavsett om du planterar rakt ut i rabatten, i krukor eller i pallkragar.
Utebelysning – guide till belysning för trädgård, fasad och uteplats
Gör trädgården och uteplatsen både trivsam och praktisk när mörkret faller. Här får du koll på olika typer av utomhusbelysning och var de passar. Du får också tips som hjälper dig att välja belysning till trädgården, uteplatsen, gångar och entré.
Vidjehortensia 'Annabelle' – plantering och skötsel
När 'Annabelle' blommar svävar stora, bollformade blomklasar över det frodigt gröna bladverket och förvandlar rabatten till ett mjukt hav av blommor. I vita, rosa eller djupt rosaröda nyanser lyser de upp trädgården från högsommar till höst och skapar den där lummiga, romantiska känslan som är svår att få nog av. Det finns flera Annabelle-sorter – hitta din favorit och få tips om hur du får den att trivas.
Japansk lönn - plantering och skötsel
Japansk lönn är ett fantastiskt lönnträd som sticker ut med sitt vackra färgrika lövverk i nyanser av rött, gult och orange. Här går vi igenom hur du planterar och sköter om din japanska lönn så att den tillför en ny dimension i din trädgård.
Perenner i rabatt och kruka – plantering och skötsel
Perenner är ett samlingsnamn för växter som kommer igen år efter år, och det finns otaliga sorter att välja mellan. Det allra vanligaste är att plantera perennerna i marken, men många perenner gör sig också bra i stora krukor.
Växter på balkong och terrass
Förgyll din balkong eller uteplats med grönska och blommor. Med stora krukor och balkonglådor kan du skapa en härligt grönskande oas med härliga balkongväxter, även på hög höjd mitt i staden.
Plantagen – Tillsammans får vi det att växa
Hos oss handlar allt om det som växer – växter, trädgårdar, hem och idéer. I totalt 90 butiker i Sverige och Norge möter du 1500 engagerade medarbetare som gärna hjälper dig att lyckas med nya projekt, stora som små. Så att alla kan få växa – både växter och människor.

Sebago Technics Acquires Lincoln/Haney Engineering Associates, Expanding into Structural Engineering Services and Strengthening Midcoast Maine Presence
BRUNSWICK, MAINE – Sebago Technics, a Maine-based, multi-disciplinary engineering consulting firm, announced the acquisition of Lincoln/Haney Engineering Associates, a Brunswick-based structural engineering firm with 40 years of experience serving clients throughout Maine and the United States.
This strategic acquisition strengthens Sebago Technics’ presence in the Midcoast region and adds structural engineering capabilities to the company’s existing range of services.
Founded in 1984, Lincoln/Haney Engineering Associates has earned a distinguished reputation for providing high-quality structural engineering services across a diverse range of projects, including commercial and residential construction, municipal and industrial facilities, educational and civic buildings, healthcare facilities, and mixed-use developments. The firm specializes in new construction, renovations, historic building restorations, and structural assessments.
“Lincoln/Haney Engineering Associates has spent four decades building trusted relationships with clients throughout Maine. Their commitment to personal service, technical excellence and long-term partnerships aligns perfectly with Sebago Technics’ client-focused approach.” said Mark Adams, President/CEO of Sebago Technics.
Lincoln/Haney’s structural engineering capabilities encompass all aspects of structural analysis, design, evaluation, development of construction documents, and construction phase administration services. The firm has excelled in developing innovative solutions to complex project challenges while maintaining a strong focus on meeting schedule and budget requirements.
“We are excited to be joining Sebago Technics,” said Michael Cunningham, President of Lincoln/Haney Engineering Associates . “Sebago’s employee-owned structure, additional services and collaborative culture create new opportunities for our team and our clients, while preserving the personalized service we’ve always valued.” The acquisition represents a significant milestone in Sebago Technics’ strategic growth plan, establishing a strong presence in Maine’s growing Midcoast region while expanding the company’s service offerings to include structural engineering. Lincoln/Haney’s expertise in working closely with multidisciplinary design teams will enhance Sebago Technics’ ability to provide comprehensive, integrated engineering solutions.
Lincoln/Haney Engineering Associates will continue to operate from its Brunswick location, with all team members joining the Sebago Technics family. Clients can expect the same high level of service and expertise they have come to rely on, now backed by the expanded resources and capabilities of a larger local organization.
About Sebago Technics Sebago Technics is a 100% employee-owned multi-disciplinary engineering consulting firm providing innovative solutions to public and private sector clients throughout Maine and Northern New England. With a commitment to excellence and client satisfaction, Sebago Technics offers a comprehensive range of services including civil engineering, landscape architecture, surveying, planning, transportation, environmental services, and now structural engineering.
For more information or questions about our services and projects please contact us .

Walter P. Stinson, PE, founded Sebago Technics in 1981 with a vision to build a company that brings disciplines together to better serve clients. Today, as a 100% employee-owned firm, every project we take on is personal. We bring together engineers, surveyors, landscape architects, planners, environmental scientists, and designers who care deeply about the outcome—because we each have a stake in the results.
Our work is our reputation. That’s The Sebago Way : a culture of ownership, trust, and purpose that shapes how we work, grow, and help build the future of our region.

Employee-Owned Company & Culture | Sebago Technics
Retrieved via http: https://www.sebagotechnics.com/about-us/employee-ownership/
Sebago Technics is proud to be an employee-owned company! Learn more about what it means for our employees, the ownership, and culture of Sebago Technics.
Employee-Ownership
Learn more about the ownership and culture of Sebago Technics.
How it Works
What is an ESOP?
An ESOP, or Employee Stock Ownership Plan, is a type of retirement plan in which a trust holds stock for its beneficiaries, the employee-owners. To set up an ESOP, the employer creates a trust fund to which it contributes company stock and/or cash to buy stock (either new or existing shares). Unlike 401(k) plans, all contributions to ESOPs come from the employer. Companies may be partially employee-owned (where one or more individuals or groups maintain ownership over a certain percentage of the company and the remaining percentage is owned by the employees), or 100% employee-owned, as Sebago is.
Incorporated in September 1981, Sebago Technics spent its first few months working out of Founder Walter Stinsons’ house in Windham. Subsequent moves followed as growth and opportunity allowed and the firm moved into its current space at 75 John Roberts Road, South Portland in 2012.
On December 31, 1998, the ESOP was implemented. The year 2000 marked an exciting time in the company’s history. Building on our early Total Quality efforts and subsequent reorganization in the mid-90s, the ESOP purchased its first batch of shares, which placed Sebago Technics on the path to becoming an employee-owned company.
At the start of the new millennium, the Sebago Technics ESOP Trust owned nearly 10% of the company. In October of 2003, the Sebago ESOP reached another milestone when a major transaction took place which brought the Trust ownership to 62% achieving “majority ownership” of the company. In 2007, Sebago Technics became 100% owned by the Trust.
Why it Matters
The Importance of Employee-Ownership
The future of the company is measured by the hard work and dedication of its employees. The ESOP provides each person a share in the firm’s growth and prosperity. Future challenges will be met and conquered with the same spirit of teamwork and enthusiasm that has defined our firm over the past 30+ years. As an employee-owned company, we, as employees, will determine our individual and collective success.
A company, like a stool, is supported by three equally important legs: its customers, its people, and its management. Long-term survival of a company is a function of its ability to maintain this strong underpinning because a collapse of any leg will destroy the company.
The success of Sebago Technics can be largely attributed to its people. In recognition of that fact, the ESOP ownership model was chosen for the company to continue beyond the first generation of ownership. The ESOP provides direct benefits to the people who have defined the culture, history, spirit, and success of the organization. Federal legislation was enacted in the late 1990s which enabled small companies, such as Sebago Technics, to transfer ownership of the company to employees through the ESOP model.
This was a win-win situation. The ESOP provided the critical financial mechanism, and it created the opportunity for everyone in the company to share in the firm’s growth and prosperity. It provided the existing shareholders a way to recoup the value of the company without closing the doors or transferring the company’s assets through an outside sale.
As a qualified employee benefit program, administration and implementation of the ESOP are protected by federal law. Everyone can be assured that the program meets the applicable legal standards. The ESOP provides retirement benefits because employees sell their share of company stock when they reach retirement age. The value of each account is directly related to the company’s success, and everyone knows that their efforts help determine the stock value.
The Advantages of Being an Employee-Owner
You own shares in the company without any out-of-pocket expense.
You contribute to the financial success of the company.
You share in the financial success of the company.
You have access to information that illustrates how your actions and decisions affect company profitability.
You have the right to vote on certain decisions about the company’s future.

Institutionelle Mandate | Encavis
Retrieved via http: https://www.encavis.com/gruenes-kapital/institutionelle-mandate
Encavis bietet institutionellen Investoren strukturierte Mandatslösungen für nachhaltige Investitionen in erneuerbare Energien. Unser Ansatz verbindet langjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Energieanlagen mit professionellem Asset Management.
Wir bieten institutionellen Investoren ​ Komplettlösungen für nachhaltige Geldanlagen
Wir sind überzeugt, dass zwischen ökonomischen und ökologischen Interessen kein Widerspruch besteht
die zahlen sprechen für uns
2,3 Mrd.
Euro Gesamtinvestitionsvolumen verwalten wir derzeit für institutionelle Investoren
Mandate managen wir derzeit für institutionelle Investoren
100%
Fachkundige Beratung
Spezialisierter Anlageberater für nachhaltige Geldanlagen
Ein neues Mandat verlangt zu Beginn zwingend eine umfassende Analyse der Erwartungen, u. a. von Gewinn, Laufzeiten, Risikomanagement und Regulatorik sowie die marktseitigen Möglichkeiten im Portfolioaufbau. Wir hören unseren Kunden sehr genau zu und entwickeln gemeinsam die passende Investitionsstruktur – vom Einzelmandat bis zur Fondslösung. Unerlässlich über die gesamte Betriebsphase einer Investition sind die Optimierung und Steuerung des Portfolios in Bezug auf Wirtschaftlichkeit und Anforderungen in der Risikomessung wie zusätzliche Vorgaben der Aufsichtsbehörden. Sie werden durch unsere jeweiligen Experten in der Mandatsbetreuung gewährleistet. Im Ergebnis erhält jeder Investor auf seine individuellen Anforderungsprofile abgestimmte Berichte, Bewertungen sowie Empfehlungen im technischen Betrieb der Anlagen.
Unser Angebot für Institutionelle Investoren
Asset Sourcing
Jährlich werden uns eine Vielzahl von Projekten aus unserem Branchennetzwerk oder von externer Seite angeboten. Sie alle durchlaufen einen mehrstufigen Prüfungsprozess, der wirtschaftliche, technische und rechtliche Aspekte auswertet. Das versetzt uns in die Lage, unseren Investoren fortlaufend eine volumenstarke Pipeline aus europäischen Wind- und Solarparks anbieten zu können.
Regulatorik
Das Erfüllen regulatorischer Anforderungen ist essenziell für die meisten unserer Institutionellen Investoren. Ob MaRisk, Solvency oder Anlageverordnung. Wir begreifen diese Bedürfnisse als Auftrag und schaffen für jede Fondslösung regulatorische Berichte, die den Anforderungen unserer Kunden und den Aufsichtsstellen entsprechen. Das wird uns auch von Verbänden und Prüfstellen immer wieder bestätigt.
Operatives Management
Im operativen Management kümmern wir uns neben der stetigen Ertrags- und Kosten­kontrolle unter anderem um das Gewähr­leistungs- und Ver­sicherungs­­management, die Zusammen­­arbeit mit Partner­unternehmen, Netz­betreibern, Grund­stücks­eigentümern und den Behörden vor Ort sowie die Steuerung der technischen Dienst­leister. Diese Leistungen sind un­erlässlich, um mit den Solar- und Windparks dauerhaft stabile Erträge zu erwirtschaften.
Portfoliostrategie
Unsere Portfolio Manager verfügen über umfassende Erfahrungen im Bereich der Erneuerbaren Energien. Sie liefern Institutionellen Investoren neben dem regulatorischen und kaufmännischen Reporting eine Fülle weiterführender mandatsspezifischer Informationen und Services. Dieses Know-how, gepaart mit transparenten Unternehmensprozessen und einem effektiven Risikomanagement, ermöglichen uns, hochwertige Portfolios aus Wind- und Solaranlagen zu schaffen und langfristig erfolgreich zu managen.
Fondslösungen
Luxemburgische Erneuerbare-Energien-Fonds (AIF) unterliegen den höchsten europäischen Regulierungsstandards und gewährleisten so einen umfassenden Service und Komfort. Wir passen uns deiner Struktur an oder organisieren für dich eine passende Lösung.
Grüne Taxonomie
Unsere Anlageberatung inkludiert auch mögliche nachteilige Nachhaltigkeitsauswirkungen. In welchem Umfang und auf Basis welcher konkreten Indikatoren diese betrachtet werden, hängt von den Wünschen der Kunden ab. Erst nach Bewertung der relevanten, den Kundenwünschen entsprechenden ESG-Kriterien, wird ein Wind- oder Solarpark in das Portfolio aufgenommen.
Wir schätzen die breite Streuung des EIF II Portfolios über Energiegewinnungsarten, Länder und Standorte hinweg sowie die lösungsorientierte Mentalität des Encavis Teams.
Herbert Schädler
Senior Director – Alternative Investments, BayernLB
Als ökologisch ausgerichteter Energie- und Umweltdienstleister ist es für uns wesentlich, unsere Erzeugungskapazität für erneuerbaren Strom weiter auszubauen. Die Kooperation mit Encavis AM stärkt unsere Rolle als Motor der Energiewende.
Matthias Welss
Geschäftsführer
Seit Jahren arbeiten wir bei zahlreichen Wind- und Solarprojekten mit Encavis Asset Management zusammen. Dabei haben wir das Unternehmen als kompetenten Partner kennengelernt.
Isabella Pütz
Head of Projects Sales EMEA
Encavis Portfolio Management GmbH

=== PAGE: faqs ppas | https://www.encavis.com/de/encavis-energy-solutions/faqs-ppas
faqs-ppas | Encavis
Retrieved via http: https://www.encavis.com/de/encavis-energy-solutions/faqs-ppas
PPAs mit Encavis – verständlich erklärt, ohne Kleingedrucktes
Keine Fachbegriffe. Keine unnötige Komplexität. Nur klare Antworten auf die Fragen, die wirklich wichtig sind.
Häufig gestellte Fragen
Klassische Stromverträge orientieren sich häufig an kürzeren Beschaffungszyklen und den aktuellen Marktbedingungen. PPAs werden in der Regel über längere Laufzeiten abgeschlossen und können Unternehmen mehr Transparenz und Planungssicherheit für ihren zukünftigen Energiebedarf bieten.
Encavis unterstützt dich dabei, das Beschaffungsmodell zu finden, das am besten zu deinen Zielen und deinem Risikoprofil passt.
Je nach Ausgestaltung kann ein PPA Unternehmen dabei helfen:
Die Kostenplanung zu verbessern
Die Abhängigkeit von volatilen Großhandelsmärkten zu reduzieren
Eine langfristige Energiebeschaffungsstrategie aufzubauen
Zugang zu erneuerbarem Strom zu sichern
Jede Lösung wird individuell auf die Anforderungen deines Unternehmens zugeschnitten.
Wie jede langfristige Beschaffungsentscheidung sollte auch ein PPA sorgfältig geprüft werden. Faktoren wie Veränderungen im Stromverbrauch, Marktentwicklungen oder die Vertragsstruktur spielen dabei eine wichtige Rolle.
Encavis begleitet dich während des gesamten Bewertungsprozesses, damit Chancen und relevante Aspekte umfassend verstanden werden.
Nicht jedes Unternehmen entscheidet sich dafür, 100 % seines Strombedarfs über ein PPA abzudecken.
Encavis analysiert gemeinsam mit dir das Verbrauchsprofil und bewertet Beschaffungsmodelle, die zu den operativen und wirtschaftlichen Zielen deines Unternehmens passen.
Nein.
Viele Unternehmen kommen mit wenig oder gar keiner PPA-Erfahrung zu Encavis. Unsere Aufgabe ist es, den Prozess verständlich zu machen, Optionen transparent aufzuzeigen und dich bei jeder Entscheidung zu begleiten.
PPAs können technische, wirtschaftliche und regulatorische Anforderungen mit sich bringen. Du musst diese Herausforderungen jedoch nicht allein bewältigen.
Encavis Energy Solutions begleitet dich von der ersten Analyse über die Vertragsstrukturierung bis hin zur Umsetzung und dem laufenden Support.
Verbrauchsmuster verändern sich im Laufe der Zeit. Daher spielt Flexibilität häufig eine wichtige Rolle in der Energiebeschaffung.
Bei der Entwicklung einer Lösung berücksichtigt Encavis dein erwartetes Verbrauchsprofil und bespricht geeignete Strukturierungsoptionen, um zukünftige Veränderungen möglichst zu berücksichtigen.
Viele Unternehmen sind an mehreren Standorten, Regionen oder in verschiedenen Ländern tätig. Abhängig von deinem Energiebedarf und Verbrauchsprofil kommen unterschiedliche Beschaffungsmodelle infrage.
Encavis Energy Solutions ist in mehreren europäischen Märkten aktiv und unterstützt dich bei der Bewertung geeigneter Lösungen.
Ein PPA ermöglicht den Bezug von erneuerbarem Strom, ohne dass du selbst Erzeugungsanlagen besitzen, finanzieren oder betreiben musst.
Ein guter Ausgangspunkt ist ein Verständnis deines Stromverbrauchs, deiner Beschaffungsziele und deines Planungshorizonts.
Auch wenn nicht alle Informationen sofort verfügbar sind, hilft Encavis dabei, die relevanten Daten für eine fundierte Bewertung zu identifizieren.
Viele Unternehmen sind zunächst unsicher, ob ein PPA die richtige Lösung für ihre Situation ist.
Das erste Gespräch mit Encavis dient dazu, deine Ziele, dein Energieprofil und deine Beschaffungsherausforderungen besser zu verstehen. In einigen Fällen kann ein PPA die passende Lösung sein, in anderen bieten sich alternative Ansätze an.
Im ersten Gespräch möchten wir dein Unternehmen, deinen Stromverbrauch und deine Prioritäten im Energieeinkauf kennenlernen.
Auf Basis dieser Informationen besprechen wir mögliche nächste Schritte und bewerten, ob eine vertiefte Analyse sinnvoll ist.
Encavis vereint Expertise in der Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien, Beschaffungskompetenz, Marktverständnis und operative Umsetzung.
Anstatt eine Standardlösung anzubieten, entwickeln wir gemeinsam mit dir einen individuellen Ansatz, der Ziele, Herausforderungen und Verbrauchsprofil berücksichtigt. Unser Fokus liegt auf praxisnahen Lösungen, die langfristig erfolgreich umgesetzt und gesteuert werden können.
Lass uns mit deinen Fragen starten
Egal, ob du dich zum ersten Mal mit PPAs beschäftigst oder bereits konkrete Beschaffungsoptionen prüfst: Wir unterstützen dich gerne.

Accessibility (U.S. National Park Service)
Retrieved via http: https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/accessibility.htm
The National Park Service is committed to making facilities, programs, services, and employment accessible for visitors and employees with disabilities.
Accessibility
The National Park Service is committed to making facilities, programs, services, and employment accessible for visitors and employees with disabilities. Each park has its own accessibility section on its website, where details can be found about planning a trip to that park with accessibility needs in mind.
If you experience any difficulty accessing the information on our website, please email us with details of the issue .
Plan an Accessible Park Trip
The Access Pass
The Access Pass is a free lifetime pass available to US citizens or permanent residents of the United States that have been medically determined to have a permanent disability (does not have to be a 100% disability). The Access Pass provides benefits at federal lands managed by six agencies, including free entrance to parks managed by the National Park Service that charge an entrance fee.
Learn more or acquire an Access Pass .
Architectural Barriers Act (ABA)
The Architectural Barriers Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. §§ 4151--57) requires access to facilities that are designed, built, altered, or leased with federal funds. The Access Board is the federal agency responsible for enforcing the ABA. Read the ABA standards or learn how to file an ABA-related complaint , if you encounter a problem while in a park.
More Information
Each park is responsible for providing information about planning a trip to that site with accessibility in mind. Visit a specific park's website to learn specific information, such as whether wheelchairs are available to borrow, what accessible camping options there might be, etc.
Overview of accessibility in national parks
Service animals in parks
How to use the Telecommunications Relay Service (TRS) to contact a park
Accessibility of This Website
The National Park Service is committed to making its information and communication technologies accessible to individuals with disabilities by meeting or exceeding the requirements of Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, as amended. Section 508 is a federal law that requires agencies to provide individuals with disabilities access to electronic and information technology and data comparable to those who do not have disabilities, unless an undue burden would be imposed on the agency.
To meet this commitment, our web templates have been designed to meet or exceed the Section 508 standards and to conform to the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.0, Level A & AA. Individual parks are responsible for ensuring their content (documents, videos, etc.) adheres to this standard.
The Section 508 standards are the technical requirements and criteria that are used to measure conformance with the law. More information on Section 508 and the technical standards can be found at Section508.gov . These standard incorporate the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.0 as well.
National Park Service Section 508 Contact
If you have feedback or concerns related to the accessibility of any content on this website, or have ideas or comments that would help us improve the accessibility and usability of our website, please email the National Park Service Section 508 Program Coordinator, Alex Lindeman . If applicable, please include the web address or URL and the specific problems you have encountered.
Complaints
The National Park Service is a bureau within the Department of the Interior (DOI). If you would like to file a formal Section 508 related complaint, please submit the complaint in writing to the Department of the Interior Office of Civil Rights by by email , by phone at 202-208-5693, or in writing at the following address:
U.S. Department of the Interior Office of Civil Rights 1849 C St NW, MS 1559, Washington, D.C. 20240-0036
The Office of Civil Rights will apply the complaint procedures outlined in 43 CFR Part 17, Subpart E , which are established to implement Section 504 for resolving allegations of discrimination in a Federally conducted program or activity.
Information for Current and Prospective Employees
Veteran Hiring Program
The Feds Hire Vets Program , in the Department of the Interior (DOI), offers information on how military veterans may apply for federal jobs, including at the National Park Service.
Reasonable Accommodations for Employees
The Access Center (formerly called the Assisted Technology Center) is a Department of the Interior resource center that offers consultation, information, advice, and demonstration of assistive technology, safety, and accommodation solutions to increase workplace accessibility and safety for all employees.
Additional Information for People with Disabilities
Disability.gov is a federal government website that provides comprehensive information on disability programs and services in communities nationwide.

Working Parent and Family Supports
Paul, Weiss recognizes the challenge of being a caregiver and provides comprehensive benefits and policies to support our lawyers who have caregiving responsibilities including:
Working Parent Related Benefits: 12 weeks of paid parental leave, comprehensive infant transition support, multiple options for backup emergency childcare and access to additional services to help our attorneys manage work and life. To enhance support for the transition to parenthood, we have a liaison to help parents navigate benefits and firm resources.
Alternative Work Schedule Program: Reduced hours work arrangements are available to all attorneys. Several associates have been promoted to partner while in the program, which has no tenure requirement and can be requested for any reason.
Work-Life Coach: The firm engages a leading specialty consulting firm that provides coaching to working parents and organizations that employ them. Our on-retainer consultant is available to couples or individuals to discuss their needs and concerns, including how to support their school-age children.
The Family Network provides support to working parents and those with adult and other caregiving responsibilities by fostering community, increasing awareness of available benefits, programs and policies and sharing tips and strategies for managing multiple responsibilities.

Customers experienced one vacation journey but the platform was designed to serve many different needs. Pleasant Holidays (A | T Collective's flagship brand) needed a way to create greater clarity and simplicity for travellers while preserving the flexibility required by advisors and partners.
Pleasant Holidays operates one of the travel industry's largest vacation booking platforms, serving travellers, travel advisors, and partner organizations through a shared digital ecosystem. Over time, the platform evolved primarily around operational and agent needs, creating a consumer experience that felt complex, difficult to navigate, and increasingly disconnected from modern traveller expectations. The organization needed to modernize its booking experience without disrupting the systems that powered its business, while also providing greater flexibility for partners and preserving the trusted service standards that differentiated the brand. The challenge was not simply to redesign a website. Pleasant Holidays needed to rebalance its entire ecosystem around the traveller while creating a platform capable of supporting multiple audiences, evolving business needs, and long-term growth.
Travel planning involves multiple audiences, interconnected systems, and long consideration cycles. Pleasant Holidays needed a platform that could support travellers, travel advisors, partners, and internal teams without sacrificing usability. We approached the transformation as a platform and experience evolution, redesigning the ecosystem around traveller needs while preserving the systems, integrations, and business processes of the broader organization. The result is a more adaptable foundation that supports consistent experiences across audiences while enabling the organization to evolve and scale over time.
From operational complexity to connected travel experiences.
We helped establish a flexible foundation capable of supporting multiple audiences, partner autonomy, and future growth while maintaining consistency and operational stability across the travel ecosystem. A documented API architecture, flexible multisite ecosystem, shared components, and governance framework enabled progressive deployment and reusable feature delivery while preserving local autonomy where needed.

aktuelles
Zwei Künstler – ein Motiv: Max Slevogts impressionistische Gemälde und Zeichnungen und Candida Höfers zeitgenössische Fotografien beleuchten den Zoo aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven.
Während Slevogt die Käfiggitter malerisch auflöst und das Tier in den Fokus rückt, macht Höfer Architektur und Barrieren zum Hauptmotiv. Die Gegenüberstellung ihrer Werke zeigt, wie radikal unterschiedlich ein und dasselbe Sujet interpretiert werden kann – und regt im Dialog mit der naturkundlichen Sammlung dazu an, den eigenen Blick zu hinterfragen: Wie verändert sich unsere Wahrnehmung, wenn wir das Gleiche durch unterschiedliche Augen sehen?
Die Kabinettausstellung ist bis zum 27.6.2027 in den KunstWelten zu sehen.
Von seinen Zeitgenossen gefeiert, von der Nachwelt nahezu vergessen: Das Werk des früh verstorbenen Malers Philipp Klein (1871–1907) wartet darauf, wiederentdeckt zu werden. Der Mannheimer Autodidakt begeisterte schon zu Lebzeiten mit seinem unverkennbaren Gefühl für Licht und Farbe. In seinen atmosphärischen Momentaufnahmen scheint die Welt im flirrenden Wechselspiel von Helligkeit und Bewegung aufzugehen.
Gemeinsam mit den Reiss-Engelhorn-Museen Mannheim präsentiert das Landesmuseum Hannover erstmals eine umfassende Würdigung dieses außergewöhnlichen Künstlers. Zahlreiche der rund 100 gezeigten Werke waren jahrzehntelang in privaten Sammlungen verborgen und sind nun erstmals wieder öffentlich zu sehen. Die Ausstellung bietet einen faszinierenden Einblick in Kleins Vielfalt: von Strand- und Gartenlandschaften über eindrucksvolle Porträts bis hin zu facettenreichen Frauenbildnissen. Ergänzt durch Arbeiten seiner bekannten Wegbegleiter*innen – darunter Lovis Corinth, Max Liebermann und Paula Modersohn-Becker – wird Philipp Kleins wohlverdienter Platz im impressionistischen Kosmos eindrucksvoll neu sichtbar.
Es gibt Neues in den WechselWelten: Ab sofort zeigt das Landesmuseum Hannover in Zusammenarbeit mit der Organisation SOS Humanity und der Universität Hildesheim die Kabinettschau »Menschen. Leben. Retten«. Thematisch widmet sie sich dem Überqueren von Grenzen, insbesondere über Wasserwege, und der zivilen Seenotrettung im Mittelmeer. Das Kooperationsprojekt greift den Aspekt von Booten und Bewegung als Teil der Migrationsgeschichte auf, wie er in den MenschenWelten präsentiert wird, und ergänzt im letzten Raum der Dauerausstellung eine aktuelle Perspektive: Während Migration historisch als Motor von Entwicklung sichtbar wird, steht sie heute häufig im Zusammenhang mit politischen Konflikten. Erstmals werden Fotoarbeiten von Fotograf*innen, die Such- und Rettungseinsätze von SOS Humanity im Mittelmeer begleitet und aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven dokumentiert haben, in einem Museum präsentiert. Ergänzt durch Toninstallationen kommen sowohl gerettete Menschen als auch Mitglieder der zivilen Seenotrettung zu Wort.
Die Kabinettschau wurde von Dr. Vanessa Zeissig und Studierenden des Instituts für Kulturpolitik der Universität Hildesheim inhaltlich und gestalterisch konzipiert und in den Rundgang der MenschenWelten integriert.
Die optimale Begleitung beim Ausstellungsrundgang: Unser »MediaGuide« hält digitale Rundgänge durch unsere Dauer- und Sonderausstellungen mit vielen zusätzlichen Infos bereit – und das ganz bequem auf Ihrem eigenen Smartphone (Kopfhörer nicht vergessen!). Los geht’s!

faq
Warum hat das WeltenMuseum montags geschlossen?
Das Museum ist an Montagen zwar für Besucher*innen geschlossen, aber hinter den Kulissen herrscht Hochbetrieb. Arbeiten in unseren Ausstellungsräumen zum Beispiel können nicht während der regulären Öffnungszeiten erledigt werden.
Montags werden die Welten auf Vordermann gebracht: Exponate ab-und aufgebaut, kleinere und größere Reparaturen erledigt, die Technik gewartet etc. – Am Dienstag ist dann wieder alles »auf Hochglanz poliert« und bereit für unsere Besucher*innen.
Darf man in den Ausstellungen Fotos machen?
Das Fotografieren ohne Blitz und Stativ ist in den Sammlungen des WeltenMuseums grundsätzlich erlaubt. Das Blitzlicht würde den ausgestellten Objekten zu sehr schaden. Außerdem würden Blitzlicht und Stativ andere Museumsbesucher*innen stören.
Ob das Fotografieren in den Räumen der Sonderausstellungen gestattet ist, variiert und hängt von der aktuell gezeigten Sonderausstellung ab. In den Sonderausstellungen sind oftmals auch Exponate von unterschiedlichen Leihgeber*innen zu sehen. Den Leihgeber*innen gehören auch die Bildrechte für die Ausstellungsstücke, deshalb dürfen wir unseren Besucher*innen ggf. nicht erlauben, Fotos von diesen Objekten zu machen. Ob das Fotografieren in der aktuellen Sonderausstellung erlaubt ist, erfahren interessierte Besucher*innen über die Info oder an der Kasse.
Gibt es einen Audioguide?
Unser »MediaGuide« führt Sie durch unsere Sammlungen und Sonderausstellungen. Nutzbar ist der » MediaGuide « ganz einfach auf dem eigenen Smartphone (Kopfhörer nicht vergessen!).
Ist das Museum barrierefrei zugänglich?
Das Museum ist eingeschränkt barrierefrei. Ausführliche Informationen zur Barrierefreiheit im Landesmuseum Hannover finden Sie hier .
Gibt es einen Wickeltisch?
Aber selbstverständlich. Im Erdgeschoss zwischen dem Eingang zum Innenhof und dem Museumscafé Schönwald’s ist ein Sanitätsraum eingerichtet, in dem ein Wickeltisch mit Wickelablage bereitsteht.
Kann ich mit Kinderwagen ins Museum kommen?
Der Museumseingang ist über eine Rampe auch mit Kinderwagen problemlos erreichbar. Im Erdgeschoss stehen Abstellmöglichkeiten für eine begrenzte Anzahl Kinderwagen zur Verfügung. Wenn möglich bitten wir darum, diese auch zu nutzen und den Kinderwagen aufgrund des begrenzten Platzes nicht mit in die Ausstellungsräume zu nehmen. Bei sehr hohem Besucheraufkommen behalten wir es uns zudem vor, den Zugang zu den Ausstellungsräumen für Kinderwagen zeitweise zu beschränken.
Wo kann man Jacken und Rucksäcke aufbewahren?
Große Taschen und Rucksäcke sind in den Ausstellungsräumen nicht gestattet. Jacken, Taschen und Rucksäcke können in den Schließfächern im Erdgeschoss eingeschlossen und sicher verwahrt werden. Dafür benötigt man nur eine 1 € Münze als Pfand für den Schlüssel.
Die Vereine und Freundeskreise unterstützen materiell und ideell die Arbeit der einzelnen Abteilungen. Darüber hinaus bieten die meisten Vereine eigene Veranstaltungsprogramme für ihre Mitglieder an, wie beispielsweise Führungen, Vorträge und Exkursionen. Zu vielen dieser Veranstaltungen sind auch Nicht-Mitglieder herzlich eingeladen.
Nähere Auskünfte – auch über Mitgliedschaften – erhalten Sie direkt bei den Vereinen und Freundeskreisen.

Créé en 1988 et filiale à 100% de Renault Group depuis 2017, Renault Vehicle Innovation est un constructeur de véhicules innovants à énergies alternatives. Spécialisée dans la transformation et la conversion de véhicules utilitaires, bus, minibus et camions, l'entreprise met son expertise au service des constructeurs automobiles sur le marché européen. Basée en France, son centre de R&D et son expertise industrielle lui permettent de proposer aux constructeurs automobiles des solutions sur mesure, pour répondre aux besoins de mobilité lourde et d’utilitaires légers des professionnels.
DATE DE CRÉATION : 1988, filiale de Renault Group depuis 2017
RAISON SOCIALE : Renault Vehicle Innovation
MARQUE COMMERCIALE : PVI et sa filiale ESCAL
FORME JURIDIQUE ET RÉPARTITION DU CAPITAL : Renault Vehicle Innovation : SAS (Société par Actions Simplifiée), au capital de 6 M€, détenue à 100% par Renault Group ESCAL : SAS (Société par Actions Simplifiée), détenue à 100% par Renault Vehicle Innovation

ESCAL : SAS (Société par Actions Simplifiée), détenue à 100% par Renault Vehicle Innovation
ACTIVITÉS : Transformation lourde de véhicules utilitaires, bus, minibus et camions pour diverses applications de transport de personnes ou de marchandises. Conversion de véhicules utilitaires et camions aux énergies alternatives électrique, hybride rechargeable , GNV ou hydrogène, ou vers la mobilité autonome. Carrossage et maintenance de véhicules utilitaires, matériels lourds et engins spéciaux via sa filiale ESCAL.

EFFECTIFS : une équipe d’environ 100 personnes
SUPERFICIE : 45 000 m2 dont 15 000 m2 couverts
CERTIFICATION : ISO 9001
Recherche & Développement en mobilité lourde et légère et conversion énergétique
L’équipe Recherche & Développement de Renault Vehicle Innovation conçoit la transformation de véhicules utilitaires et de camions et leur conversion éventuelle à une autre énergie. Elle dispose de chefs de projets expérimentés et de bureaux d’études spécialisés en mécanique, électricité, électronique et logiciels. Son atelier de prototypage de véhicules et d’essais permet de valider les innovations. Enfin, un service d’homologation assure la conformité des véhicules aux normes réglementaires.
Transformation et conversion énergétique de véhicules utilitaires et camions
L’équipe de production transforme des véhicules utilitaires pour des applications spécifiques (minibus et châssis cabines), et met en œuvre des motorisations pour énergies alternatives. Elle dispose pour cela d’ateliers d’assemblage, de peinture et de contrôle et d’essai pour garantir la qualité des véhicules produits. Enfin, un magasin de pièces et un service logistique soutiennent l’activité de fabrication.
Carrossage, maintenance et réparation
L’équipe de carrossage, maintenance et réparation offre un service complet pour les matériels lourds et les engins spéciaux. Dotée d’un atelier de carrossage, d’un atelier de maintenance et de réparation, d’une plateforme de service après-vente et d’un magasin de pièces de rechange dédié, l’équipe garantit un service de qualité. Des techniciens de dépannage itinérants sont disponibles pour intervenir sur le terrain.
Produits
Renault Master Citybus E-Tech
Conçu et fabriqué en France, Renault Master Citybus est un minibus de ville de 22 passagers (segment M2 classe A). Avec sa chaîne de traction et sa batterie de dernière génération, ainsi que ses 16 systèmes d’aides à la conduite, il associe performance et sécurité. Basé sur un design spécifique avec plancher bas intégral, Renault Master Citybus E-Tech garantit l’accessibilité et le confort de tous.
En savoir plus
Renault Master Shuttle E-Tech
Renault Master Shuttle E-Tech est un minicar de 14 passagers (segment M2 classe B). Conçu et fabriqué en France, comme Renault Master Citybus, il bénéficie de la même architecture à plancher bas intégral, avec un aménagement intérieur spécifique pour véhicule de classe B. Equipé des mêmes chaîne de traction et batterie dernière génération, il dispose également des 16 systèmes d’aides à la conduite. Il est dédié en particulier au transport à la demande.
Renault Trafic Van E-Tech electric
Après avoir électrifié Renault Master à partir de 2018, Renault Vehicle Innovation a développé, homologué et électrifie Renault Trafic Van pour la marque Renault depuis 2023.
Renault Trucks D19
Renault Vehicle Innovation transforme le châssis D18 (18 t) voie large de Renault Trucks, en châssis D19 (19 t) voie étroite, pour des usages de Bennes à Ordures Ménagères (BOM) en centre-ville. En effet, les métiers de la collecte requièrent d’accéder aux endroits les plus exigus : voies étroites, centres villes historiques, chaussées spécifiques…
Services
Service clients après-vente et pièces de rechange
A l’écoute, notre service après-vente répond aux besoins d’assistance technique de nos clients et distributeurs. Il fournit toutes les informations concernant nos catalogues et tarifs de pièces de rechange, et nos manuels de réparation, détaillant les temps de main d’œuvre associés. Il permet d’obtenir rapidement un devis et d’être en dialogue constant avec nos équipes.
Nos équipes après-vente interviennent en France et en Europe via notre réseau de distributeurs des produits Renault Vehicle Innovation ou via notre équipe de techniciens itinérants hautement qualifiés.

Qualité
Renault Vehicle Innovation est certifié ISO 9001. Toutes nos équipes ont acquis les compétences garantissant la qualité de nos véhicules.
